name: Drag Drive Simulator
robloxName: (WHEELIE STYLE x BIG UPDATE) Drag Drive Simulator
creator: ADV Gamers Team
redeem: Launch Drag Drive Simulator on Roblox and wait for the map to load.
Click the shopping cart (Store) icon at the bottom-left of the screen.
Open the Redeem tab at the top of the Store window.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Code Here box and press Redeem.
notes:
Drag Drive Simulator, also known as DDS and a revamp of the older RDID, is a driving and roleplay game from ADV Gamers Team set on maps modelled on Indonesian streets, including Surakarta. You take jobs such as barista, courier, office worker or police officer to earn RP, then spend it on cars and motorcycles, tuning parts, rims and wheelie styles, and cruise or race with friends.

Codes give large amounts of RP, often tens of millions, which goes straight toward new vehicles and modifications. The team usually drops a new monthly code named after the month, adds more with each big update, and promises extra codes when the game reaches like milestones such as 200,000 likes.

faq.q: When is the next Drag Drive Simulator code coming out?
faq.a: The game description says the next code will be released when the game reaches 200,000 likes. The developers also usually add a monthly code named after the month, such as DRAGDRIVESIMULATORSEPTEMBER26, and add more codes with big updates. The latest Wheelie Style update added five.

faq.q: What can I spend the RP from Drag Drive Simulator codes on?
faq.a: RP is the game's in-game cash, and codes often give tens of millions of it. You can spend it on cars and motorcycles, tuning parts, rims and wheelie styles.

faq.q: Where is the code box in Drag Drive Simulator?
faq.a: Click the shopping cart (Store) icon in the bottom-left corner, then open the Redeem tab at the top of the Store window. Enter the code in the Enter Code Here box and press Redeem.
